messages:
Alex: Quick thread for Nimbus POC (FinOps). Need final hosting call: they require EU-only processing, KMS, and a tight latency target. Budget for POC: ~$3k credits.
Priya: I can own evals and prompts. Primary use case is billing explanations + vector search. Target: recall@5 >= 0.9 and explainability stability across runs.
Ben: Infosec: they want BYOK and 90-day audit log retention. BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted can do CMKs in some regions but needs legal addendum. I'll ping legal and request SOC2 docs from them.
Sam: Infra notes: For p95 < 300ms at 256 tokens we should plan Dedicated in eu-west-1. Hosted route possible for quick start but no guaranteed SLO. Private on-prem is possible but >3 weeks.
Marta: Sales ops: we can give $3k hosted credits or a discounted Dedicated trial rate. Need finance approval for Dedicated discount.
Priya: Proposed POC success criteria (customer-facing):
- Accuracy: vector recall@5 >= 0.90 on their gold set
- Perf: embeddings p95 < 120ms; gen p95 < 300ms at 256 tokens
- Stability: <=10% variation across repeated explanation prompts
- Ops: KMS rotation + logs to their SIEM
- Cost: <= $3k credits or agreed Dedicated trial fee
Alex: Timeline: 10 business days. Day0-2 contracts/PO, Day3 infra + smoke, Day4-8 load + evals, Day9 results. Can we provision Dedicated in 48-72h after PO?
Sam: Yes, approx 48-72h after PO for a small Dedicated trial cluster in eu-west-1. Hosted is immediate. Private excluded for POC.
Ben: Carol (client infosec) is copied on questionnaire. I'll request SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, and KMS attestation. Also ask for required data flows for DPIA.
Priya: Sharing the curl we'll use for golden checks: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2","input":["invoice line item","charge explanation"]}'```
infra-bot: Ticket created #POC-4720 5: Dedicated trial (eu-west-1). Owner: Sam. Est. provisioning 48-72h after PO.
Marta: Action items: Priya -> eval set + prompts by EOD; Ben -> legal/infosec docs; Sam -> infra PR; Alex -> confirm credits/PO with client.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll update CRM and ask Carol for PO by Thursday.
